_about: Single source of every limit and fixed message the Xynotransit API enforces. The Rust constants live in src/rules.rs (module msg for the messages); the test rules_json_matches_code fails when this file and the code drift apart. The Flutter tests read this file too (../xynotransit-api/tests/fixtures/rules.json). Limits count characters (not bytes) after trimming, except value_*, period_*, trend_* and max_*. Messages containing {name} are templates: {what} is name, country or role (reporter) or count or target (listed twice); {label} is the count name; {month} is the long month name; {left} is a number. Deck text limits live in deck_text_defaults.json. Keep this file stable: add keys, never rename or remove one.

email.shape: local@domain.tld: trimmed, lowercased, one @, no spaces, control or invisible characters, none of < > ( ) , ; : \ " [ ], domain has a dot that is not first, last or doubled.

messages.team_long: A team name can have at most 60 characters.
messages.name_long: A name can have at most 80 characters.
messages.role_title_long: A role title can have at most 80 characters.
messages.plain_line: Use plain text on one line.
messages.metrics_too_many: A seat can have at most 8 counts.
messages.metric_long: A count name can have at most 60 characters.
messages.metric_duplicate: Two counts have the same name. Give each count its own name.
messages.kpis_too_many: A seat can have at most 10 targets.
messages.kpi_long: A target can have at most 200 characters.
messages.reporter_long: Your {what} can be at most 80 characters.
messages.reporter_plain: Your {what} must be plain text on one line.
messages.value_not_yours: One of the numbers does not belong to this report.
messages.kpi_not_yours: One of the targets does not belong to this report.
messages.month_outside: A number is for a month outside this period.
messages.value_twice: A number was entered twice for the same month.
messages.kpi_status: Answer each target with met, partly or missed.
messages.value_too_big: A number can be at most 1000000000.
messages.kpis_left: Answer all targets in step 3 ({left} left).
messages.comment_long: A comment can be at most 200 characters.
messages.note_box: A note is in a box that does not exist.
messages.notes_too_many: Write at most 3 notes per box.
messages.note_same_number: Two notes in the same box have the same number.
messages.note_long: A note can be at most 70 characters.
messages.trend_range: The trend must be a number from 1 to 24.
messages.too_many_links: Too many links requested. Try again later.

passwords._about: Sign-in limits: login_failures_per_pair (5) wrong tries per (username, client address) per login_window_minutes lock that pair only; login_failures_per_username_backstop (100) from any addresses lock the name for everyone except addresses that signed in successfully for it within trusted_address_days; login_failures_per_address (30) apply only to a client address the server can determine. login_failures_per_username is the old name of the pair limit and is kept. A session that began with a sign-in link may choose a new password without the current one for link_recovery_minutes. Usernames and passwords (added later; the sections above are unchanged). Password length counts Unicode scalar values, spaces are kept exactly as typed, nothing is trimmed. The policy checks run in the order of policy_order and the first that fails gives its message. A password may not equal (ignoring case) the username, the email, the part of the email before the @ or the full name. Run = every character is the next or every one the previous, ignoring case, digits wrap around (1234567890). common_list is embedded in the API (src/common_passwords.txt, lowercase compare, every entry 10 characters or longer); the Dart demo may use a shorter list.

messages.username_invalid: Usernames use letters, digits, dots, dashes and underscores, 3 to 40 characters.
messages.login_too_many: Too many sign-in attempts. Try again later.
messages.busy: Busy, try again in a moment.
messages.password_control: Use letters, numbers, spaces and symbols only.
messages.password_personal: Do not use your username, email address or name as a password.
messages.password_run: Do not use a simple run such as 1234567890 or abcdefghij.
messages.password_common: That password is too common. Pick something only you would think of.
messages.password_current_wrong: Your current password is not right.
messages.password_same: Choose a password different from the current one.
messages.too_many_resets: Too many temporary passwords created. Try again later.
messages.manager_only: Only the manager can do this.
